ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.noTransactionsDesc: Your ledger is empty. Add a transaction to start seeing your history.
ledger.noFilteredTransactions: No transactions found matching your filters.

trash.title: Recently Deleted
trash.subtitle: System Trash
trash.infoText: Items you delete are sent here. Restoring an item will put it back in your ledger, accounts, or categories list.
trash.emptyDesc: Discarded items will neatly stack up here.

settings.title: General
settings.subtitle: Preferences & Sync
settings.demoModeDesc: You are using Moniq locally. Sign in with Google to enable cloud sync across devices and automated backups to your Google Drive.
settings.privacyNote: Your financial data is 100% private. Moniq does not have a central database; instead, all your transactions and settings are securely backed up to a dedicated spreadsheet inside your personal Google Drive.
settings.backupDesc: Moniq automatically creates snapshots of your data at specific intervals. Clicking Backup Now immediately creates a new manual snapshot (up to 5 are retained). Each backup is saved as a new copy in the "Moniq Backups" folder in your Google Drive — existing backups are never overwritten.
settings.defaultDateFormat: Default date format across the app
settings.resetAllDataDesc: Permanently wipe all transactions, accounts, and categories from this device and your Google Sheet. This action cannot be undone.
settings.localDataWiped: All local data will be wiped.
settings.googleSheetCleared: All data in your Google Sheet will be cleared.
settings.returnToOnboarding: The app will return to the onboarding state.
settings.confirmReset: Yes, I understand and want to reset all data
settings.unsavedChangesDesc: You have {{count}} changes that couldn't be saved to Google Drive due to a network error. If you sign out now, these changes will be lost.

account.createDescription: Create an account to track its balance and transactions. You can add more payment methods or edit details later in Settings.
account.editDescription: Update the details for this account.
account.displayNamePlaceholder: e.g., Bank Account, Cash Wallet, Credit Card
account.assetTooltipText: Money you own (e.g., savings bank account).
account.savingsAccountTooltip: Balances from savings accounts are used to calculate your total savings and goals.
account.excludeFromNetWorthTooltip: If checked, this account's balance won't count toward your total net liquid assets.
account.openingBalanceTooltip: The initial amount of money in this account when you start tracking.
account.tooltip: Accounts are the core of Moniq. They represent places where your money lives (like Bank Accounts or Wallets) or money you owe (like Credit Cards or Loans). Every transaction requires an account. You should create an account for each place where your money lives or where you owe money like individual bank accounts, individual credit cards etc.

category.tooltip: Categories organize your income and expenses into a hierarchy. Drag to reorder within groups.
category.subtitle: Expense & Income Classification
category.createDescription: Create a category to group your transactions. You can manage and edit categories later in Settings.
category.editDescription: Update the details for this category.
category.initialBalanceTooltip: Opening balance for tracking external items like Investments or Loans
category.head: Head (Main Category)

method.title: Payment Methods
method.tooltip: Payment Methods represent how you pay — like UPI, Credit Card, or Cash. When you add a transaction, selecting a method auto-fills the linked account. A default method is created automatically for every new account. Drag to reorder.
method.nameTooltip: A recognizable name for this payment method (e.g., UPI, HDFC Debit Card). Used to identify it when adding transactions.
method.linkedAccountTooltip: Link this method to an account. When you select this method during a transaction, the linked account will be auto-filled, saving you a step.
method.archiveTooltip: Archive to hide this method from new transactions without losing history.
method.deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this payment method? This cannot be undone.

home.heroSubtitle: Seamless personal finance tracking powered by your own Google Drive.
home.heroDescription: Your data is yours. We don't even have a backend to store it. Your logs sync directly, securely, and privately to a hidden spreadsheet inside your own Drive. We couldn't look at your ledgers even if we tried.

dashboard.welcomeDesc1: Your ledger is a blank canvas. Tap the + button
dashboard.title: Dashboard
